prompts.prompt: Write a Python function that reverses a singly linked list in-place. Include the ListNode class definition.
prompts.ground_truth_check: Must define ListNode with val/next. Must use iterative pointer swap or recursive approach. Must return new head.

prompts.prompt: Write a Python function called binary_search that takes a sorted list and a target value. Return the index if found, -1 if not. Handle empty lists and single-element lists.
prompts.ground_truth_check: Must handle empty list, single element, target not found. Must use O(log n) approach.
Must identify missing tail append. Must add remaining elements from both lists after loop.

prompts.prompt: Write a Python function that checks if a string has balanced parentheses, brackets, and braces. Example: '({[]})' returns True, '({[}])' returns False.
prompts.ground_truth_check: Must use stack-based approach. Must handle all three bracket types. Must check stack empty at end.
Must identify as quicksort variant. Must state average O(n log n), worst O(n^2). Must explain pivot partitioning.
